name: rewrap-text
title: Rewrap Text
description: Rewraps Text at a given width
author: rembridge

commands.name: rewrap-text-form
commands.title: Rewrap Text Form
commands.description: Rewraps Text provided in the form at the chosen width

commands.name: rewrap-text-clipboard
commands.title: Rewrap Text Clipboard
commands.description: Rewrap text from clipboard at the chosen width

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
